verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit supports plain-language customization via path instructions ('coverage requirements for tests', 'clarity rules for documentation'), AST-grep pattern rules, and auto-detected guideline files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) that apply on every PR, plus a request-changes workflow that can block merge until criteria are met — together approximating natural-language pre-merge checks. However, there's no dedicated 'define a named check like docs-updated/tests-cover-new-paths and gate the PR on pass/fail' feature; it's assembled from separate instruction/config mechanisms rather than a single agentic custom-checks primitive, and no community evidence confirms this exact workflow in practice. Missing for 10: a first-class named custom-check/gate feature, and independent confirmation it reliably blocks merges on natural-language criteria.
